name: Underground Stream
description: You break through into a cavern with a rushing underground river.
The wall gives way and cold spray hits your face — an underground river roars past in the dark.
A river you did not know existed carves through the rock ahead of you, fast and unlit.

success.description: You cross safely and find coins on the far bank.

risky_option.label: Dive in and search the riverbed

success.description: You surface clutching a fistful of treasure!

failure.description: The current drags you back. You lose ground.

name: Gas Pocket
description: A foul-smelling green gas seeps from a crack in the wall.
Your lantern flame turns sickly green. Something is leaking through the rock.
A hiss. A smell. A color gas has no business being. You hold your breath on instinct.

success.description: You wait it out. Fresh air returns.
The gas was harmless! And behind it—gems!

failure.description: The gas ignites! BOOM!

name: Techies' Hidden Cache
description: A suspicious pile of barrels marked with a smiley face. Squee, Spleen, and Spoon were here.
Barrels. Stacked in a pyramid with a crayon smiley taped to the top one. You do not hear giggling. Probably.
Someone left a tidy pile of explosives in the tunnel. The 'Do Not Dismount' sticker is a nice touch.

success.description: Smart choice. You hear a muffled 'aww' from behind the wall.
KABOOM! A new passage opens up—and some coins fly out!

failure.description: KABOOM! ...in the wrong direction. Techies sends his regards.

name: Meepo's Lost Clones
description: Three identical Meepos are arguing about which way is up.
A Meepo is loudly disagreeing with himself. Four times, in perfect unison, except when he isn't.
Several Meepos are pointing in different directions and all shouting 'this way!' with complete confidence.

success.description: They thank you and leave a tip. 'We were never here.'

risky_option.label: Trust the clones to lead you deeper

success.description: Four Meepos carve through rock at terrifying speed!

failure.description: They lead you in circles. You lose the way.

name: Cursed Chest
description: An ornate chest sits in the middle of the tunnel, glowing faintly purple.
A chest has been placed dead center in the passage. It hums. The floor around it is suspiciously clean.
A gilded box sits in the tunnel, radiating a faint purple glow. Its lock has no keyhole.

success.description: Wisdom is its own reward. (You find a coin on the ground.)
Jackpot! The 'curse' was just mood lighting!

failure.description: The chest bites you. Yes, bites.

name: Lost Miner
description: A bewildered miner is wandering in circles, muttering about 'the surface.'
Another miner stumbles past, eyes hollow. 'Which way's up?' they ask. They don't wait for an answer.
A figure in mining gear walks by in the wrong direction, mumbling to a pickaxe they no longer carry.

success.description: They give you a grateful nod and a couple coins.

risky_option.label: Ask them to help you dig deeper

success.description: Together you make great progress!

failure.description: They panic and cause a minor collapse.

name: Crystal Golem
description: A golem made of shimmering crystals blocks the path. It seems to be... sleeping?
Something the size of an ox, built entirely of crystal shards, snores softly against the tunnel wall.
A crystalline giant is crumpled in a heap like it laid down for a nap and forgot to get up.

success.description: You sneak past. A crystal chip falls—finders keepers.
You harvest rare crystals before it wakes!

failure.description: It wakes up. It's not happy.

name: Mushroom Grove
description: A bioluminescent mushroom grove fills a side chamber with soft blue light.
Glowing mushrooms the size of your head carpet a small chamber. The light is almost the color of the sky.
You step into a grotto lit only by living blue fungus. It's beautiful and slightly wrong.

success.description: The beauty inspires you. Somehow you dig better.
Incredible! You can see through walls! ...temporarily.

failure.description: Your stomach disagrees violently. Time lost.

name: Magma Geyser
description: The ground rumbles. A vent of superheated steam shoots up ahead.
A low hiss becomes a shriek. Ahead, scalding steam jets from a crack on a timer you don't know.
You feel the heat before you see it — a magma vent blasting straight up through the tunnel.

success.description: Patience pays off. You continue safely.
You dash through and find a treasure cache behind!

failure.description: Terrible timing. You get steamed like a dumpling.

name: Ancient Elevator
description: A rickety mine elevator with frayed ropes. A sign reads: 'Use at own risk.'
A wooden lift dangles from rope that is, charitably, half of what it should be. The platform creaks in a breeze that isn't there.
An old mine elevator sits in its shaft. Ropes frayed, sign illegible, and technically still operational.

success.description: Slow and steady. You find a coin on a step.
WHOOSH! Express to the depths!

failure.description: The rope snaps. You tumble.

name: Void Whispers
description: Unintelligible whispers echo from a crack in the abyss wall. They're... offering a deal?
A thin crack in the rock exhales syllables. You don't understand them but you know what they want.
Voices drift from a fissure, polite and patient. They have been waiting for someone to listen.

success.description: The whispers fade. Probably for the best.
The void is generous today. Dark riches are yours!

failure.description: The void takes more than it gives.

name: Friendly Mole
description: A large mole pokes its nose out of the wall and squeaks at you encouragingly.
Something soft and velvet-furred emerges from the dirt in front of you, chirps once, and waits.
A mole the size of a small dog has made a hole beside yours. It seems very pleased to have company.

success.description: The mole is delighted! It shows you a shortcut.

risky_option.label: Follow the mole into the cramped burrow

success.description: The mole leads you to its treasure stash!

failure.description: You get stuck in the burrow. Embarrassing.

name: Worm Council
description: A circle of earthworms convenes before you. They appear to be voting on something important.
Worms in a perfect ring. One of them is clearly the chair. They pause their deliberation to look at you.
Something that looks like a parliament of worms is in session. You have walked in during an important motion.

success.description: The motion passes. You are declared an honorary annelid.

risky_option.label: Bet a vote on the worms

success.description: Your vote tips the balance. The worms are grateful.

failure.description: You voted wrong. The worms are displeased.

name: Buried Lunch Box
description: A perfectly preserved lunch box from the surface. The sandwich inside is... questionable.
A tin lunch pail, rust-free despite the years, with a sandwich inside that smells neither fresh nor dead.
You unearth someone's lost midday meal. The bread is intact. That is the most alarming part.

success.description: A collector would pay good money for this.
Aged like fine wine. You feel invigorated.

failure.description: Food poisoning. Your ancestors are disappointed.

name: The Dig Dog
description: A dog is digging enthusiastically nearby. It is objectively better at this than you.
A scruffy terrier has a tunnel going in parallel to yours. It is already two blocks ahead.
A dog. Underground. Digging with the technique of a professional. It hasn't noticed you yet.

success.description: The dog teaches you a new technique. Good boy.

risky_option.label: Race the dog into the dark

success.description: You win! The dog doesn't care. It's just happy to dig.

failure.description: The dog vanishes into the dark and your bearings go with it.

name: Root Maze
description: A tangle of ancient roots blocks the path. Something metallic glints deep inside.
Old roots have woven themselves into a wall. Deep in the mesh, the reflection of something small and shiny.
The passage ends in a wall of gnarled roots. Through a gap, you catch a metallic wink.

success.description: Slow but steady. You squeeze through.
A handful of buried coins! Worth the scratches.

failure.description: Tangled. It takes an hour to free yourself.

name: Pickaxe Head Flies Off
description: Your pickaxe head detaches mid-swing and sails into the darkness. You hear it land... somewhere.
CLANG. Your pickaxe is suddenly half a pickaxe. The heavy end is out there, past the lantern light.
The head of your tool flies off mid-swing. It bounces once, twice, and is gone.

success.description: Found it! And some coins along the way.

risky_option.label: Claw through the loose rock by hand

success.description: Surprisingly effective. You find the head AND a geode.

failure.description: Your hands disagree with this approach.

name: The Toll Keeper
description: A spectral figure blocks the path. It holds out one translucent hand. 'Toll or riddle. Your choice.'
A ghost in threadbare robes stands in the middle of the tunnel. 'The usual,' it sighs. 'Coin or clever.'
Cold air thickens into a translucent shape. It has been guarding this passage for a very long time and is clearly bored.

success.description: The ghost pockets the coins somehow and steps aside.

risky_option.label: Wager coin on the ghost's riddle

success.description: 'Correct,' it says, sounding disappointed. It drops its own toll.

failure.description: Wrong. 'Everyone says fire,' it sighs. It takes your coins anyway.

name: Gravity Pocket
description: An area where gravity is... optional. Your tools float. You float. Everything floats down here.
You take one step and your feet don't come back down. Your pickaxe hovers at eye level, patient.
Something has switched off the down. You drift sideways, mildly confused, alongside a cloud of rock dust.

success.description: It does. Eventually. You feel vaguely insulted.

risky_option.label: Swim down through the unstable void

success.description: You swim through solid rock. Best not to think about it.

failure.description: You float up instead. Ceiling is farther than you thought.

name: Fossil Argument
description: Two fossils embedded in the wall face each other. They look like they were fighting when they died.
Locked in the stone, two creatures frozen mid-grapple. Nobody won. Nobody moved.
Two skeletons fused into the wall, still arguing after several million years.

safe_option.label: Leave them to their eternal dispute

success.description: Some arguments aren't worth getting between.

risky_option.label: Pry both fossils from the crumbling wall

success.description: Museum quality! Separate display cases, obviously.

failure.description: They crumble to dust the moment you touch them. Of course.

name: The Sandwich Lady
description: A woman appears from behind a stalagmite carrying a tray of baguettes. 'I didn't ask for this,' you think.
A woman rounds the corner with a tray of baguettes, as if the tunnel were a hotel corridor and you had called room service.
Someone is selling sandwiches down here. Underground. A hundred feet deep. She seems completely unbothered.

success.description: The baguette is surprisingly good. She vanishes.
She shrugs and leaves a tip jar. It has coins in it.

failure.description: She doesn't take rejection well. Baguette to the face.

name: Echo Chamber
description: Your footsteps echo in impossibly complex patterns. For a moment, you hear the steps of every miner who has ever been here.
The chamber plays your footsteps back to you, layered with the footsteps of everyone who ever stood where you stand.
You take a single step. The echo comes back as a chorus. You are not the first.

success.description: The echoes fade. You feel less alone. Somehow that's worse.
Your echo comes back with directions. And coins.

failure.description: Your echo comes back louder. Much louder. Cave-in.

name: Mirror Tunnel
description: Crystal walls reflect infinite copies of you. One of the reflections waves. You didn't wave.
The corridor is mirrored on every surface. You are reflected a thousand times. One of you is smiling.
Polished crystal on every wall. You see yourself everywhere. Then one of the yous blinks out of sync.

success.description: Smart. The reflection looks disappointed.
The reflection smiles and points to a hidden cache.

failure.description: It grabs your hand and tries to pull you through. You wrench free.

name: Resonance Cascade
description: Crystals vibrate at increasing frequency. They're about to shatter. The air tastes like ozone.
The whole chamber is humming. The pitch climbs past what your teeth can stand. Something is about to give.
Every crystal in the wall is ringing like a tuning fork. You have maybe thirty seconds before they all let go.

success.description: You make it out just as the cascade peaks. Glass everywhere.
The shatter opens a massive cavern. You're the first one here.

failure.description: The shatter opens nothing. Except your skin. Medical bill incoming.

name: Crystal Garden
description: Someone has been cultivating crystals here. Tiny signs read 'do not touch' and 'water weekly.'
A little crystal garden sits in a sconce, neatly arranged. Hand-lettered placards label each variety in a language you don't know.
Someone has been tending crystals like houseplants. There is a watering can. Nobody has been here in a while.

success.description: You find a donation jar. It's been a while since anyone else visited.
The gardener isn't coming back. These are yours now.

failure.description: The crystals fight back. They're pricklier than they look.

name: Gem Rock
description: A rock glitters with embedded gems. Mining it is risky — these rocks are known to fight back.
A boulder studded with raw gems sits in the middle of your path. It is slightly warm to the touch.
You find a lump of ore flecked with color. Everyone you know has warned you about lumps of ore flecked with color.

success.description: A modest haul. Patience rewarded.

risky_option.label: Swing hard at the warm rock

success.description: Uncut diamond! ...wait, wrong game. Still valuable though.

failure.description: The rock was a mimic. Why is everything down here a mimic.

name: Prism Trap
description: Light bends through crystal prisms creating a dazzling but disorienting maze of rainbows.
The tunnel becomes a refraction puzzle. Rainbows crisscross the floor. You can't tell where solid rock ends and colored air begins.
Prisms scatter your lantern light into a dozen false paths. Only one of them is real.

safe_option.label: Close your eyes and feel the walls

success.description: Slow but effective. You emerge on the other side.

risky_option.label: Chase the brightest beam through the maze

success.description: The light leads you true. A shortcut reveals itself.

failure.description: You walk in circles for hours. The prisms scatter your sense of direction.

name: Lava Surfer
description: A chunk of obsidian floats on a lava river. It's just barely big enough to stand on.
A slab of cooled volcanic glass rides the lava flow like a raft. The current is faster than it looks.
A river of molten rock. A single dark slab rides the surface. Someone has carved a foothold into it.

success.description: The long way. Safe, boring, and slightly damp.
You ride the rapids like a champion. The lava respects you.

failure.description: You fall in. It's exactly as hot as you'd expect.

name: Forge Spirit
description: A fire elemental hammers at an anvil. It notices you. 'Trade or fight. I don't do small talk.'
Something shaped like a man, made entirely of fire, is working an anvil. It pauses, hammer raised, and looks at you.
An elemental smith turns its burning face toward you. The anvil smokes. 'Trade. Or don't.'

success.description: It hands you something warm. Your next digs feel... enhanced.

risky_option.label: Fight the elemental for its core

success.description: You shatter the elemental. Its core is worth a fortune.

failure.description: Fire hurts. Who knew.

name: Volcanic Vent Gambit
description: A volcanic vent cycles between eruptions. The gap between bursts is exactly three heartbeats.
A geyser of fire punches the ceiling on a rhythm. One. Two. Three. One. Two. Three.
The vent ahead fires in perfect intervals. You can cross between bursts if you are brave and fast.

success.description: Patience. The vent cools after an hour.
Three heartbeats. You made it in two.

failure.description: Terrible timing. Cooked.

name: Heat Mirage
description: You see an oasis ahead. With a swimming pool. And a bartender. It's 100% not real.
The heat shimmers, and through the shimmer you see palm trees, a pool, and a man polishing glasses. It cannot possibly be there.
A resort. In a magma tunnel. The bartender even waves at you. You are not fooled. You are tempted.

success.description: You knew it wasn't real but you're still disappointed.
Wait. The bartender WAS real? Free drinks.

failure.description: It was never real. You wander, and the hours bleed away.

name: Shooting Star
description: A blazing rock tears through the cavern wall and embeds itself in the floor. It radiates warmth and value.
A chunk of sky has punched through the ceiling. The rock at the bottom of the crater is still glowing.
You watch a meteor carve a line through the cavern and thud into the ground. It hisses softly. It is yours for the taking.

success.description: Star fragments. Warm to the touch and surprisingly dense.
The core is pure stardust. Priceless.

failure.description: It explodes. Stars do that sometimes.

name: The Chasm Butcher
description: A butcher on the far side of a chasm is fishing with a meat hook. 'Fresh meat delivery service!' he calls. 'First ride's free.'
A massive butcher stands on the far rim of a chasm, swinging a meat hook over his head. 'FRESH MEAT!' he calls cheerfully. He points at you.
Across the gap, an enormous figure grins through rotten teeth. He holds a meat hook the size of your arm. 'First ride's free.'

success.description: The long way. You find coins in the crevices.
WHEEE! You arrive covered in something but 6 blocks deeper.

failure.description: The hook misses. You fall. The butcher waves sadly from above.

name: The Abandoned Workshop
description: A cluttered workshop full of half-finished gadgets. A sign reads: 'Gone to rearm. Back in 5 minutes.' The sign is 400 years old.
A workbench covered in half-built gadgets, gears, and miniature rockets. A note pinned to the wall: 'be right back'. The ink is very, very faded.
Someone abandoned this tinkerer's workshop mid-project. Half-finished inventions still hum faintly on the bench, waiting for a return.

success.description: Spare parts. Not glamorous, but sellable.

risky_option.label: Spark the half-built gadget to life

success.description: It works! A drill that practically digs itself.

failure.description: It doesn't work. It also sparks. And now your eyebrows are gone.

name: The Burrow
description: The ground cracks beneath you. Something chitinous scuttles below. It's been waiting.
A hairline fissure spreads under your boots, and beneath it, a dozen faceted eyes open at once.
The floor is thinner than it should be. Underneath, something carapaced is moving, slow and deliberate.

success.description: It lets you go. This time.
An ancient intelligence offers knowledge. Your depth for its wisdom.

failure.description: It didn't want to talk. It wanted lunch.

name: The Arcanist's Library
description: A chamber lined with tomes. An impossibly old man surrounded by floating orbs doesn't look up. 'I know why you're here,' he says. He sounds bored.
Bookshelves carved into the ice rise past your lantern's reach. A hooded figure turns a page without looking at you. 'Ask your question.'
A library that should not exist. At its center, an old man in grey robes surrounded by slow-orbiting orbs. 'Yes, yes. Come in.'

success.description: You find a primer on geological theory. +30 luminosity restored.

risky_option.label: Ask the old man about the orbs

success.description: He almost smiles. 'Choose: cold, energy, or fire.' Cold restores your light. The others... well.

failure.description: He waves his hand. You are outside, hours gone, the way back unclear.

name: The Dark Rift
description: The tunnel opens into a vast underground kingdom. A horned figure on a throne of basalt offers passage. 'Everything has a price,' it says. 'Even the ground you stand on.'
The passage empties into a throne room the size of a city. Something horned watches you from a seat carved from a single block of obsidian.
You step into an underground kingdom. A figure with antlers of black stone waits on a throne. It has been expecting you for some time.

success.description: It nods. Respect costs nothing. You find coins by the exit.

risky_option.label: Stake your passage on a challenge

success.description: You win the challenge. The throne room collapses into a shortcut.

failure.description: It wasn't really a challenge. More of a demonstration.

name: Void Market
description: Shadowy merchants materialize from nothing. They trade in concepts. 'Depth for wealth? Wealth for depth? Information for blocks?'
Three silhouettes fade into existence around you, draped in hoods that are more void than cloth. 'We barter,' one says.
The dark folds itself into the shape of merchants. They have no faces but they have terms, and the terms are fair.

safe_option.label: Trade depth for wealth (3 blocks for 6 JC)

success.description: Fair trade. Your tunnel shortens. Your wallet fattens.
The shadows accept. You feel your tunnel extend.

failure.description: The shadows take your coins and vanish. No refunds in the void.

name: Abyssal Fishing
description: A luminous pool of liquid void. Something moves beneath the surface. It might be valuable. It might be alive.
A pool so black it seems to drink the light. Beneath its surface, something large turns over slowly.
The water in this pool is not water. It ripples without wind, and something pale rises just close enough to see before sinking again.

success.description: You see your reflection. It winks. You earn 2 JC for your trouble.
Your hand closes around something cold and heavy. Treasure.

failure.description: Whatever it was, it pulled your coin purse in. And your glove.

name: Gravity Inversion
description: You are suddenly falling upward. Then sideways. Then in a direction that doesn't have a name.
Down stops working. You fall, but the fall has no direction you can put a word to.
Gravity turns inside out. Your pickaxe floats to the ceiling. You follow it, then keep going.

success.description: You cling to a stalactite until reality sorts itself out.

risky_option.label: Let yourself fall through the shifting rock

success.description: You fall through solid rock. The physics down here are generous.

failure.description: You fall up, then down, then up again. Nauseating.

name: Whispering Walls
description: The void's whispers form coherent sentences. 'We remember when this stone was sky.'
The walls are speaking. Not metaphorically. They have things to say about the age before there was rock.
For the first time down here, the whispers use words. 'We remember.' It repeats, patient, for your benefit.

success.description: The whispers fade. Some things are better left unheard.

risky_option.label: Listen to what the walls remember

success.description: '...and the hero bought a clarity and walked into the trees.' Wait, what? Still, the void pays well for listeners.

failure.description: The whispers get inside your head. They rearrange things.

name: Spore Storm
description: A cloud of bioluminescent spores erupts from the fungal walls. Beautiful. Also, you're inhaling them.
The wall ahead breathes out a sparkling green cloud. It's lovely. It's also already in your lungs.
Spores everywhere — glowing, drifting, slightly sweet. You are suddenly aware of every breath you have ever taken.

success.description: Fresh air. Relatively speaking. Everything down here is questionable.
The spores are... enhancing? You can see further and dig faster.

failure.description: Spore cough. Your lungs file a formal complaint.

name: Mycelium Network
description: The fungal root network pulses with light. Data flows through it — the locations of other tunnels.
A web of mycelium covers the chamber, and every strand pulses in sequence. It is transmitting something.
The fungus here is thinking. Light moves through its filaments the way a signal moves through a wire.

success.description: The network hums. You feel connected to something vast.
You see the depths of other miners. Knowledge is power.

failure.description: The network floods your head with other tunnels. You lose track of your own.

name: The Sporewalker
description: A humanoid made entirely of mushrooms waves at you. It offers a glowing fungal cap with the enthusiasm of someone who has never been told 'no.'
Something vaguely human-shaped, built entirely of mushroom flesh, steps forward with a glowing cap held out on its palm.
A walking mushroom lights up at the sight of you and presents a cap like a gift. It's very proud of this cap.

success.description: It tastes like earth and starlight. Your tunnel walls feel more solid.

risky_option.label: Bargain hard for a finer cap

success.description: The Sporewalker beams. The premium cap glows brighter.

failure.description: There is no premium cap. The Sporewalker is confused. And hurt.

name: Bioluminescent Cathedral
description: You emerge into a cavern so vast your lantern is unnecessary. The ceiling is a galaxy of living light.
The passage opens into a chamber the size of a cathedral. Its ceiling is alive with bioluminescent stars.
You turn off your lantern. You don't need it. The ceiling is holding its own light, and it is an entire sky.

success.description: For a moment, the weight of all that stone above you doesn't matter.
You reach the bioluminescent canopy. Up close, it's even more beautiful.

failure.description: You slip. The fall is long but the mushrooms are soft.

name: Time Eddy
description: A pocket where time runs differently. You can see your past digs playing out like ghosts ahead of you.
The air ahead shimmers. In it, you see yourself digging at a thousand different past moments, overlapping.
Time is curdled here. Your own ghost is swinging a pickaxe in the middle of the tunnel, a few minutes behind you. Or ahead.

success.description: You learn from watching your past mistakes. The future feels clearer.
Time bends around you. For a moment you exist in two places at once. Both of them dig.

failure.description: You step out and three hours have passed. Time is cruel.

name: Frozen Ancient
description: Something enormous is frozen in the ice. It has too many limbs. Most of them are wrong.
A shape the size of a whale is locked in the ice wall. Its anatomy does not match anything in any book.
A massive figure, perfectly preserved, embedded in the frozen rock. You try to count its limbs and lose count.

success.description: For posterity. And selling to tabloids.
It's warm. Organic. Worth a fortune to the right buyer.

failure.description: It moved. IT MOVED.

name: The Still Point
description: Absolute silence. Absolute cold. Absolute peace. For one perfect moment, nothing decays.
The chamber is so still that your heartbeat feels loud. The air is not cold. The air is not anything.
A pocket of impossible stillness. No sound. No temperature. No motion. You feel time stop being a factor.

success.description: The moment passes. But something lingers — your tunnel feels more permanent.

risky_option.label: Try to hold the timeless moment

success.description: You can't. But trying earned you something.

failure.description: The moment shatters. You surface unsure how long you stood there.

name: Paradox Loop
description: You meet yourself coming the other direction. You both stop. Neither of you seems surprised.
Around the next corner, you are waiting for yourself. The other you is holding a lantern at the same angle.
You see yourself walking toward you. Same pickaxe. Same dust on the boots. Neither of you reacts. You have been expecting this.

success.description: Your other self accepts. You feel generous and broke simultaneously.
You win. Or you lost. The distinction is academic at this depth.

failure.description: You lose to yourself. The hours fold back on each other.

name: The Cartographer
description: A figure with no face draws maps on the walls. The maps are of places that shouldn't exist. Some of them are accurate.
A tall figure in grey is sketching on the walls with a piece of chalk. Maps, coastlines, rooms. None of them are places you know. All of them are detailed.
A cartographer without a face hunches over a wall, drawing. The maps are of nowhere you've ever been. At least one of them is the tunnel you came from.

success.description: Your contribution is... noted. The Cartographer pays in concepts that translate to coins.
The map shows paths that shouldn't exist. They do anyway.

failure.description: The map is blank. 'That IS The Hollow,' the Cartographer explains.

name: The Final Merchant
description: A merchant who sells only one thing, and it changes every time you meet them. They seem tired of existing.
A stall in the dark. On it: one item. A single item you have never seen before. Behind it, someone who looks like they have been here a very long time.
A merchant without a stall waits in the center of the chamber. They hold one thing. You cannot quite tell what it is. 'Last one,' they say, without hope.

success.description: 'Everyone browses. Nobody buys,' the merchant says. 'Story of my life.'

risky_option.label: Gamble your coin on the merchant's price

success.description: 'Fine. Half price. Just take it.' The merchant looks relieved.

failure.description: The price doubles. 'That's what you get for haggling with the void.'

name: Memory of the Surface
description: For a moment, you remember what sunlight feels like. The warmth. The color. It hurts more than you expected.
Something in the air brings back the feeling of a summer afternoon. You stop digging. Your chest aches for reasons that have nothing to do with the tunnel.
Sunlight. Grass. The smell of a road in July. You haven't thought about any of it in a long time. The memory is sharp and cruel.

success.description: You dig with renewed purpose. Or possibly spite. Hard to tell the difference down here.
The light stays a little longer. Your pickaxe feels lighter.

failure.description: The memory dissolves and takes your sense of how long you have been down here.

name: Things in the Dark
description: You can't see what's touching your shoulder. It's warm. It might be friendly. It might not.
Something has its hand on your shoulder. You cannot see it. It is breathing, slowly, by your ear.
A pressure on your back. A warmth. It has been there for a few seconds before you noticed. The dark is too thick for your lantern.

success.description: It leaves. You'll never know what it was. Maybe that's better.

risky_option.label: Reach out to the thing in the dark

success.description: It was trying to give you something. In the dark. Normally, somehow.

failure.description: It wasn't friendly.

name: The Lightless Path
description: In total darkness, your other senses sharpen. You can hear a path the light would never reveal.
Without light, your ears start to compensate. You can hear a passage opening somewhere to your left. Air moving. A distant sound of water.
The darkness sharpens your other senses. There is a route here you could never have found with a lantern.

success.description: The sound fades. You wait for the light to return.

risky_option.label: Follow the sound into the lightless dark

success.description: The path opens into a chamber. You don't need light to feel the treasure.

failure.description: You followed the wrong sound. The dark swallows your bearings.

name: Phosphor Vein
description: Your pickaxe strikes something that glows. A vein of phosphorescent mineral splits the darkness.
You swing blind and hit something that lights up. A line of glowing mineral runs through the wall, and the tunnel starts to exist again.
A single strike and the wall begins to glow. Phosphor. A whole vein of it. The dark pulls back one step.

success.description: Light floods back. The darkness retreats. Luminosity restored.

risky_option.label: Follow the vein past the light

success.description: It leads to a mother lode. Light AND wealth.

failure.description: The vein dies and so does the light. You lose the way.

name: The Ancient's Lair
description: An ancient pit radiates power that makes your bones vibrate. Something immense stirs in the darkness. It has been here since before the stone was stone.
The tunnel ends at a pit so deep that looking into it makes you nauseous. Something down there is breathing. The walls shake in time with it.
A circular shaft opens in the floor. It does not end. Something enormous coils at the bottom, older than the rock, and it is aware of you.

success.description: Discretion is the better part of valor. The pit remembers you left.
Against all odds, the ancient falls. An aegis shard clatters to the ground. The pit is silent.

failure.description: The ancient demonstrates why it has survived since the world was young.

name: The Persistent Miner
description: A miner is shouting into the void with impressive conviction. 'Buying GF 10k!' The void does not respond.
You hear someone yelling from a side passage. 'BUYING GF 10K!' Over and over. Hope springs eternal.
A lone figure stands in a side chamber yelling into the dark. They have been there a while. They are very committed to the bit.

success.description: The shouting fades behind you. Some battles are unwinnable.
They diversify into gem trading. You get a referral bonus.

failure.description: They counter-offer. You are now somehow the one buying the GF.

name: Rock Golem
description: A tiny golem made of living rock follows you. It seems to have chosen you specifically. It cannot be discouraged.
A small figure of animate pebbles has imprinted on you. It trots behind you, stone clattering, with absolute devotion.
Something the size of a cat, made of loose rock, has decided you are its favorite person. It will not be talked out of it.

success.description: It settles on your shoulder. It's heavier than it looks.
It eats a rock and purrs. You didn't know rocks could purr.

failure.description: It bites your hand. Rock teeth. Actual rock teeth.

name: Creeper Ambush
description: A familiar hissing sound. The walls flash green. You have seconds.
Ssssssss. A green flash from behind. You know exactly what this is. You have seconds.
Something hisses at you from the dark. The walls pulse green. You recognize the timer.

success.description: You dive clear as the blast craters the tunnel behind you.
Your pickaxe absorbs the blast. The debris opens a new passage!

failure.description: The explosion sends you tumbling. Everything goes dark.

success.description: One punch. The creeper detonates harmlessly. Gunpowder everywhere — and coins!

failure.description: You punch it. It detonates. You are not Steve.

name: Abandoned Minecart
description: A rusted minecart sits on ancient rails. Something rattles inside.
An old wooden minecart rests on tracks that disappear into the dark. Whatever is inside it clinks when the cart shifts.
A minecart abandoned mid-journey. The rails vanish into the tunnel ahead. You can hear something rolling around in the cart.

success.description: A single coin wedged in the seat. Better than nothing.
WHOOSH! The cart rockets through the darkness and deposits you deeper!

failure.description: The rails end abruptly. You and the cart part ways.

name: Enchanting Table
description: Purple particles drift from a floating book. Strange symbols orbit the air.
A book hovers at waist height over a stone pedestal. Its pages turn by themselves. Purple motes drift out and fade.
A floating tome, open to a page you can't read. Runes orbit it slowly, trailing violet light.

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: Suspicious Villager
description: Hmm. A villager in a brown robe offers emeralds for... dirt blocks?
A big-nosed fellow in a brown robe holds out a handful of emeralds. He wants some of your dirt. He will not explain.
A villager blocks your path, grinning. 'Hmmm!' He gestures at a small pile of emeralds. The trade terms are written in a dialect only he speaks.

success.description: A fair deal. The villager nods approvingly. 'Hmm.'
The villager sweats. You drive a hard bargain. Emeralds rain.

failure.description: The villager slams the trading window shut. You lose your deposit.

name: The Staring Contest
description: A tall dark figure stands motionless. Purple particles shimmer. It's watching.
In the corner of the tunnel, a tall, thin figure stands perfectly still. Purple sparks drift off its shoulders. Its eyes are on you.
Something three meters tall, entirely black, perfectly still. The only motion is the slow drift of violet particles around its head.

success.description: It teleports away. You exhale.
It flinches first. It drops something valuable before vanishing.

failure.description: It shrieks. Reality bends. You are somewhere else now.

success.description: You tackle an Enderman. It drops a pearl and its dignity.

failure.description: It teleports behind you. 'Nothing personnel, kid.' Cave-in.

name: Mob Spawner
description: A cage spins in the corner, spawning skeletal shapes. Treasure chests flank it.
A wireframe cube in the middle of the chamber whirls, spitting out small skeletal figures one at a time. On either side, chests.
Bones rise out of a rotating cage. Each time it spins, another skeleton. The two chests at its base look extremely full.

success.description: You slip through unnoticed. The skeletons argue among themselves.
You snatch a chest. Arrows whiz past your ears. Worth it.

failure.description: An arrow finds your knee. The adventuring is over for today.

success.description: The cage shatters! Both chests are yours. The skeletons dissolve.

failure.description: The spawner surges. More skeletons than you can count.

name: Witch's Cauldron
description: A bubbling cauldron sits unattended. Three potion bottles labeled in illegible handwriting.
A black cauldron gurgles over a fire that was not lit by you. Three bottles rest on the rim. The labels are smeared.
Someone's cauldron. No one's witch. The brew smells like rust and strawberries. Three stoppered potions sit near the rim.

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: Azurite Deposit
description: A vein of deep blue crystal hums with stored energy. Cartographers would kill for this.
A seam of blue crystal runs diagonally across the tunnel wall. You can feel the charge in it from a meter away.
Azurite. An entire vein of it, humming. People go to war for less.

success.description: You chip out a few clean crystals. Respectable haul.
The vein cracks wide. Azurite shards scatter like blue rain!

failure.description: The blast destabilizes the passage. Crystals shatter worthlessly.

name: Crawler Breakdown
description: Your mining rig shudders and sparks. The darkness closes in around you.
The mining crawler coughs, sparks, and dies. Its lantern rig sputters. The tunnel gets a lot bigger without the light.
Your rig has picked a terrible time to break down. Something in the engine is ticking. Something behind you is not.

success.description: A patch job. It'll hold. You lost some parts though.
Sparks fly — then the engine roars. It's running better than before!

failure.description: The rig dies. The dark folds in and you lose the way.

desperate_option.label: Abandon the rig and run blind

success.description: You outrun the darkness. Barely. Your legs will remember this.

failure.description: The darkness catches you. Something in it has claws.

name: Fossil Cache
description: Fossilized remains embedded in crystal. They could be valuable... or fragile.
Something small and ancient is suspended in a chunk of clear crystal. The outlines are perfect. Too perfect to be safe.
A cluster of fossils encased in crystal like insects in amber. Intact. Priceless. And very, very old.

success.description: Careful documentation. A small finder's fee.
Pristine specimens! Collectors will pay handsomely.

failure.description: They crumble to dust the moment you touch them. Ancient and fragile.

name: Breach Encounter
description: A hand-shaped tear in reality splits open. Things pour through. Purple. Endless. Hungry.
The air in front of you splits like a seam. A purple hand, too large, emerges. Then another. Then more.
Reality bends, and then breaks. A tear in the shape of a grasping hand opens, and things come through. They keep coming through.

success.description: You back away. The breach closes. Wise.
You stand your ground. The breach yields treasure as it closes.

failure.description: The breach consumes ground you'd already claimed.

success.description: You pass through and emerge deeper. Much deeper. With loot.

failure.description: The breach spits you out. Hard. Very, very hard.

name: Vaal Side Area
description: A blood-red door pulses in the crystal. Corrupted inscriptions promise treasure and death.
A door set into the crystal wall throbs red, faintly, in time with your heartbeat. Its inscriptions are in a dead tongue, and they make promises.
The wall hides a door. The door hides an altar. The altar hides something that was once powerful and is now only hungry.

success.description: Discretion. Valor. You keep walking.
The corruption parts for you. Ancient Vaal gold awaits.

failure.description: The corruption bites. Your coin pouch feels lighter.

success.description: The altar shatters! A flood of uncorrupted treasure!

failure.description: The altar explodes. Corruption everywhere. In you. On you.

name: Syndicate Ambush
description: Cloaked figures drop from the ceiling. 'Your tunnel or your coins.'
Three cloaked figures land silently in front of you. One draws a crooked dagger. 'You know the deal.'
A syndicate crew drops from the ceiling in perfect silence. They do not introduce themselves. They don't need to.

success.description: They take your coins and let you pass. Professional thieves.
You scatter the syndicate. They drop their own loot!

failure.description: They outnumber you. The beating is educational.

name: Delve Smuggler
description: A figure from a hidden passage. 'Psst. Got the good stuff. Fell off a crawler, innit.'
A hand beckons from a hidden side passage. 'Oi. Over 'ere. Got stuff, don't ask where from.'
A grinning smuggler leans out of a crack in the wall, wares spread on a dirty cloth. 'All genuine. All completely legal. Mostly.'

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: Brann Bronzebeard
description: 'Well met, adventurer! Brann Bronzebeard, at yer service. Been mapping these depths for decades.'
A ruddy dwarf looks up from a journal and beams at you. 'Well met! Down to explore? Aye, I could use the company.'
A bearded figure in explorer's gear waves from a small camp. 'Ah, a fellow delver! Share a fire and I'll share a trick or two.'

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: Earthen Cache
description: A stone chest sealed with dwarven runes. The lock is complex but cracked with age.
A heavy stone chest rests in an alcove, bound with dwarven ironwork. The runes on the lid are mostly faded.
A runebound chest the color of mountains. The seals have been broken and rewritten many times. They are weakest now.

success.description: The lock gives way. Modest treasure inside.
The chest shatters. Dwarven gold scatters everywhere!

failure.description: The runes were a trap. The blast sends you reeling.

name: Campfire Rest
description: A warm campfire glows in an alcove. A bedroll and whetstone sit nearby.
Someone has left a campfire burning in a sheltered alcove. A neat bedroll. A whetstone on a flat rock. An invitation.
A small fire crackles in a pit, warming a space someone else clearly used as camp. Everything needed for a short rest is laid out.

success.description: You sit. The warmth seeps into your bones. A moment of peace.

risky_option.label: Sharpen your blade on the slick whetstone

success.description: The whetstone sings. Your pickaxe has never been sharper.

failure.description: You slip. A cut on the hand. It'll heal.

name: Zekvir's Shadow
description: A massive spider silhouette blocks the tunnel. Eight eyes gleam red.
The tunnel ends in legs — eight of them, too long, folded against a body the size of a house. Eight red pinpricks focus on you.
A shape the size of a barn occupies the chamber ahead. Only the eyes move. They move to you.

success.description: A detour. Longer, but you keep your limbs.
You toss a rock. It turns. You sprint. Heart hammering.

failure.description: Eight eyes. All looking at you. It pounces.

success.description: Against all odds, you drive it back! Legendary loot drops!

failure.description: Zekvir wraps you in silk. The ceiling collapses.

name: The Dark Rider
description: A cloaked rider on a skeletal mount emerges from fungal mist. It extends a gauntlet.
Out of the spore-mist rides a figure on a horse made of bones. The rider is cloaked. The rider extends a gauntlet.
A horseman parts the fungal fog. Both rider and mount are skeletal. A gauntleted hand rises in a greeting, or a demand.

success.description: It drops a coin as tribute. Respect, it seems, has value.
A cold grip. Knowledge flows into you. Secrets of the deep.

failure.description: The grip tightens. It takes something from you.

success.description: Your pickaxe meets spectral steel. You win. The mount is yours — briefly.

failure.description: The rider's lance finds its mark. You crumple.

name: Titan Relic
description: An ancient device of impossible complexity. Three runes glow: red, blue, gold.
A relic built by hands that were not human sits on a plinth. Three runes orbit it slowly. You are invited to touch one.
A device older than the rock around it hums at chest height. It offers three glowing options. You do not know what they mean.

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: The Candle
description: A single candle burns impossibly in the frozen dark. Its light is warm. It shouldn't be here.
In the middle of the ice, a single candle burns. No drafts. No breath. No reason. Its light reaches further than it should.
A candle sits on a simple iron holder in the frozen dark. Its flame is steady. Its warmth is real. Its presence makes no sense.

success.description: The flame passes to your torch. The candle keeps burning.

risky_option.label: Take the candle and walk on

success.description: It comes free. The warmth follows you. Two coins fall from the wax.

failure.description: The flame gutters out in your hand. The dark closes over your bearings.

name: Olympian Boon
description: A divine light pierces the darkness. 'Choose wisely, mortal. My gift is not given lightly.'
A column of golden light punches down through the stone ceiling. Inside it, the silhouette of a god. A voice you cannot refuse says: 'Pick one.'
The air fills with the scent of ozone and olive oil. Something vast and divine is paying attention to you specifically. It has a gift.

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: Charon's Toll
description: A boat drifts on an underground river. The ferryman extends a bony hand.
A skiff glides silently along a black river. At its prow, a robed figure holds out a skeletal palm, waiting.
The river here is still and the ferryman is silent. The price is the price. It has always been the price.

success.description: Coins clink into skeletal fingers. The boat glides forward.
The ferryman tilts his head. 'Amusing.' He lets you ride free.

failure.description: 'No.' The boat drifts away. You wasted your time.

success.description: You yank the oar and paddle furiously. Charon watches, impressed.

failure.description: Charon capsizes the boat. You sink. You surface somewhere worse.

name: Sisyphus's Request
description: A man pushes an enormous boulder uphill. 'Help me,' he wheezes. 'Just one more push.'
A lean, exhausted man leans against an enormous round stone, straining to roll it up a slope. He turns his head. 'Help. Please. Just this once.'
A figure pushes a boulder up an incline that is somehow both a corridor and a hill. He has been doing this for a long time. His eyes are very tired.

success.description: Together, you move it an inch. He smiles. 'That's enough.' He tips you.

risky_option.label: Loot the camp under the rolling boulder

success.description: While he pushes, you find his stash. He won't notice for eternity.

failure.description: The boulder rolls back — onto your foot.

name: Infernal Gate
description: A gate of black iron sealed with chains. Beyond: combat sounds and clinking gold.
A massive iron gate wrapped in chains. Through the bars: the sound of a battle and the unmistakable clink of spilled coin.
An infernal gate blocks the passage, chained shut from the far side. Beyond it, you can hear fighting, and gold, and something laughing.

success.description: Some doors are best left closed.
The chains fall. Gold spills through the gap.

failure.description: Something reaches through the gap. It pulls you in.

success.description: The gate flies open. An arena of riches, and you've already won.

failure.description: The gate opens both ways. What was inside is now outside. With you.

name: Riki's Ambush
description: You feel watched. A shimmer in the air. Suddenly — a blade at your throat. 'Surprise.'
The air behind you displaces. Something cold touches your neck. 'Hello,' says a voice you cannot see.
A rustle. A shadow that isn't yours. Then a blade, polite and patient, resting against your throat. 'Don't turn around.'

success.description: He takes the coins and vanishes. At least you're alive.

risky_option.label: Throw dust and call his bluff

success.description: Dust of Appearance! Riki panics. He drops his stash.

failure.description: He blinks behind you. Classic Riki.

success.description: You catch the blade and twist. Riki squeaks and flees, leaving everything.

failure.description: Blades are sharp. This is not a revelation. It is a reminder.

name: Bounty Rune
description: A golden rune hovers in a side chamber, spinning gently. It pulses with energy.
A rune spins in a pocket of open air, throwing off flecks of gold. It hums, patient, on the verge of paying out.
In the middle of a small side chamber, a bounty rune rotates slowly, dripping light. It's been there a while. It's ready.

success.description: Gold flows into your pockets. Easy money.
It splits into three! Triple bounty!

failure.description: It fizzles. You get the scraps.

name: The Arcane Trial
description: An old wizard materializes in a flash of arcane energy. 'Another one. Let's see what you're made of.'
A flash of arcane light and a robed figure with a deep hood steps into the tunnel. 'So,' the wizard says, without enthusiasm. 'Another applicant.'
The passage fills with light and the smell of burnt ozone. An old wizard crosses his arms and sighs. 'Let's get this over with.'

success.description: The wizard shrugs. 'Your loss.' He vanishes in a puff of condescension.
You survive the gauntlet. He slow-claps. 'Not bad.'

failure.description: The trial overwhelms you. The wizard yawns.

success.description: 'Bold.' He hands it over. Power surges through you.

failure.description: 'Greedy.' He snaps his fingers. You are elsewhere.

name: Tormentor
description: A colossal stone figure blocks the path. Lightning crackles across its surface. It does not move. Yet.
Something taller than the ceiling, shaped like a man and built of basalt, stands motionless in the passage. Arcs of lightning run along its joints.
A Tormentor waits in the middle of the chamber. It has been waiting for an age. The lightning in its seams says it is almost ready to stop waiting.

success.description: You give it a wide berth. It watches you leave.
Critical hit! The Tormentor crumbles. Its core is priceless.

failure.description: It wakes up. Lightning everywhere. You regret this.

success.description: You pour everything into one strike. The Tormentor EXPLODES.

failure.description: It absorbs your energy and uses it against you. Badly.

name: Neutral Item
description: A defeated jungle creep lies in the corner. Something glints in the debris.
A slain creature sprawls against the tunnel wall, clearly not killed by you. Something catches the light in the mess around it.
A dead neutral lies near the wall. Whatever killed it left the body. In the debris, something valuable peeks out.

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: The Gambling Den
description: A cave lit by guttering candles. Three goblins run a card game. 'Sit down,' one grins.
In a candlelit alcove, three goblins hunch over a card table. One glances up and kicks out an empty stool with his foot. 'Fresh blood. Sit.'
A gambling den tucked into a side passage. Three green-skinned dealers, a deck of cards, and a single empty seat.

success.description: You observe. One goblin slips you a coin for the audience.

risky_option.label: Play a hand against the goblins

success.description: Full house! The goblins pay up, grudgingly.

failure.description: The goblins cheat. Of course they cheat.

success.description: You stare down three goblins and win. They flip the table.

failure.description: You lose everything. A goblin pats your shoulder. 'Better luck next time.'

name: Item Goblin
description: A small green creature sprints past carrying a bulging sack. Gold coins scatter.
Something small and green hurtles past you at knee height, clutching a sack twice its size. Coins trail behind it in an arc.
A goblin pelts down the tunnel on short legs, dragging a bulging loot bag. Gold leaks from a hole in the bottom.

success.description: Free money on the ground. No complaints.
You corner it! The goblin surrenders the sack.

failure.description: It's faster than it looks. You trip on a stalagmite.

success.description: WHAM! You and the goblin slide across the cave floor. The sack is yours!

failure.description: You miss. You slide into a wall. The goblin laughs.

name: The Mystery Lever
description: A lever protrudes from the wall. It's labeled 'PULL ME' in crayon. This can't end well.
A wooden lever sticks out of the tunnel wall. Above it, in red crayon: 'PULL ME'. Below it, a crude smiley. Everything about this is a warning.
Someone has installed a lever in the middle of nowhere and labeled it, with great enthusiasm, 'PULL ME'. You consider your options.

success.description: A hidden panel opens. Coins spill out. Crayon was right!
The wall rotates! A secret passage opens, blasting you forward!

failure.description: The lever breaks. The ceiling groans. Run.

name: The Identity Thief
description: A shapeshifter has stolen your face. It's telling other miners YOUR tunnel is abandoned.
You round a corner and see yourself, talking to two other miners, gesturing at your tunnel. Your double is in the middle of saying it is abandoned and free for the taking.
Something has taken your face. It is wearing it down the passage and confidently lying about you.

success.description: Bureaucracy wins. The shapeshifter is fined. You get a small settlement.

risky_option.label: Stake your name on the crowd

success.description: 'Which one is the real one?' You prove it. The crowd sides with you.

failure.description: The crowd picks the other one. You are escorted away from your own tunnel.

name: Ancient Blessing
description: A voice older than stone: 'You have walked this path before. I remember. Choose your gift.'
A presence that is not a person speaks to you from every direction at once. 'Old friend. You always come back. Choose.'
The air hums with attention. A voice, patient and ancient, says: 'I remember you. Take what you need.'

success.description: You decline.

risky_option.label: Leave, but pocket a loose coin on the way out

success.description: You pass on the offering and scoop up a stray coin instead.

name: Fool's Vein
description: A vein of glittering ore runs along the wall. Half of it looks like pyrite. The other half might be real.
The wall sparkles impossibly. Some of it is gold. Some of it is painted rock. You can't tell which.
An offer so good it has to be a trick — or does it? The ore shines back at you, unreadable.

safe_option.label: Pocket a sample and move on

success.description: A steady hand keeps a steady coin. You take the small find.
The vein is real! A jackpot rattles into your pack.

failure.description: Pyrite. Worthless. Dust rains down and so do a few of your coins.

name: Siren's Hollow
description: A low, sweet hum drifts out of a fissure. Something is singing. The sound promises gold.
The stones vibrate with a melody that feels like it's shaping itself to what you want.
A voice behind the magma whispers a price, then offers to forget the price.

safe_option.label: Ignore the song and keep digging

success.description: The hum fades as you pass. Nothing lost, nothing gained.

risky_option.label: Follow the singing into the hollow

success.description: A small hoard glimmers in the hollow. You walk out richer.

failure.description: The song ends and so does your luck. Coins slip from your belt.

name: Hex-Cursed Shrine
description: An old altar, still warm. The offerings on it are fresh. The curse on it is older.
A shrine to a forgotten dig-god. The coins around it look untouched. That's probably fine.
Carvings around the pedestal spell out a warning. Unfortunately, you cannot read dwarvish.

success.description: A small offering left in thanks. The shrine accepts your respect.

risky_option.label: Take the offerings off the cursed altar

success.description: The shrine lets you keep them. This time.

failure.description: The hex lands. You feel lighter — mostly in the coin pouch.

name: Trickster's Toll
description: A tollgate in the middle of nowhere. A skeleton leans against it, grinning. 'Coin, or coin?' it asks.
A polite sign reads 'Pay the toll or play the toll'. Neither option looks appealing.
Someone set up a toll booth inside the mines. The operator refuses to explain how.

success.description: A few coins change hands. Nothing more.
The skeleton shrugs and waves you through. You keep what you have.

failure.description: Bad game, bad luck. The toll collects itself.

name: Gambler's Rest
description: A small tavern tucked into the rock. The sign reads 'Gambler's Rest - No Refunds'.
Dim lanterns, sticky tables, and a dealer who smiles a little too much. Just one hand.
The tavern has no name written, only painted dice. The dealer is already shuffling.

success.description: You drink. You leave. You are none the poorer.
The dice smile on you. A tidy pile slides your way.

failure.description: The house always wins. Even down here.

name: Lumber Collapse
description: A support beam groans. Somewhere distant, a tunnel just gave up.
The rock around you shifts. Elsewhere in the network, someone else's ceiling comes down.
A deep shudder passes through the whole mine. You feel people stumble.

success.description: You steady the beam. The mine breathes again.
The beam creaks, settles, holds. You pocket a small find.

failure.description: The collapse cascades through the network. Two other diggers' stashes get buried with it.

name: Wealth Siphon
description: A crystalline node pulses faintly. It tugs at the wealth in the air itself.
The node hums at the frequency of coin. Somewhere above, three very rich people feel a chill.
The deeper you dig, the louder the siphon sings. It is a very hungry song.

success.description: You pass without engaging the siphon.
The siphon pulls from the richest pockets in the guild and dumps a cut into yours.

failure.description: The siphon sputters and coughs. Nothing happens.

name: Tunnel Network Breach
description: You break through into another tunnel. The digger on the other side is not pleased.
The wall is thinner here than it should be. You hear muffled cursing on the far side.
A draft of someone else's stale air hits you. Apparently three of you share this rock.

safe_option.label: Back off and shore it up

success.description: You seal the breach. The other diggers never notice.
You crash in and come out with a pile of whatever was lying around.

failure.description: The collapse spreads down the network. Three other diggers lose coin to the cave-in.

name: Sulphite Drought
description: Your Voltaxic reserves sputter. Niko's crawler rattles to a halt.
The fuel gauge bottoms out mid-delve. The darkness leans in a little closer.
You squeeze the last drop of sulphite from the canister. It isn't enough.

success.description: You retreat to the last checkpoint. No coin, but you're alive.
Residual sulphite crystals line the cracks — you bottle what you can.

failure.description: The fracture widens onto blackness. You lose the trail of fuel and time.

success.description: The crawler roars back to life on azurite fumes. Deeper you go.

failure.description: The crawler chokes on the impurity. You're in the dark, down a lot of coin.

name: Throne of Aul
description: A vast ice cavern opens. Aul the Crystal King regards you from a frozen throne.
Spears of ice rotate around a seated figure at the cavern's far end. He does not speak.
The walls become mirrors. The Crystal King's spear volleys rotate in three different directions.

success.description: You back out the way you came. The ice follows you a little too far.
You thread the needle. A Hollow Fossil lies at the throne's base.

failure.description: A spear catches your shoulder. You leave a trail of coin on the way out.

success.description: Impossible, and yet — you strike a chip from the throne itself. The hoard is yours.

failure.description: The spears rotate through you. The throne is unchanged.

name: Kurgal's Circle
description: A bone-lich floats above a cracked obsidian floor. Abyssal wraiths spool from his fingers.
The Blackblooded raises a summoning hand. The tunnels behind you have gone very quiet.
Kurgal's eyes find you. The wraiths begin their patient spiral outward.

success.description: You hug the wall and slip past. Kurgal does not turn.
You shatter the summoning. Kurgal retreats into the obsidian.

failure.description: A wraith slips past you and out into the network. You hear distant screaming.

success.description: The beacon binds Kurgal in his own circle. His hoard is yours.

failure.description: The beacon detonates. Kurgal's wraiths scatter across the whole network.

name: Flare Starvation
description: Your last flare gutters. At the edge of the light, six pairs of Stalker eyes.
The darkness takes a slow breath. You have one flare left. The Stalkers are patient.
Something in the tunnel ahead just learned your light radius. You have very little left.

success.description: The flare catches. The Stalkers recede for now.
You make the next checkpoint before the light dies. A small score.

failure.description: A Stalker brushes you and the flare dies. The dark erases your bearings.

success.description: You cross a tunnel wall and lift a flare from another digger's pack. Their problem now.

failure.description: The flare snaps in your hand. The Stalkers close in.

name: Resonator Gamble
description: A brass-ringed resonator hums from the cavern wall, four empty fossil sockets waiting.
The resonator's sockets glitter with old crafting potential. The fossils in your pack start rattling.
Niko's laugh echoes somewhere: 'Try it. What's the worst that could happen?'

success.description: A modest crafting bonus, banked. You move on.
Chaotic resonance, but the output is real coin.

failure.description: The Aberrant shatters. Your pack is lighter by a fossil.

success.description: The resonator sings. Gem-tag currency cascades out of the socket.

failure.description: A Hollow Fossil does not forgive bad company. The resonator detonates.

name: Brann's Gambit
description: Brann Bronzebeard winds up a throw. You don't recognize the potion in his hand.
'Catch!' Brann shouts, a little too cheerfully. The vial is already airborne.
Brann has been rummaging again. He is smiling in a way that does not comfort you.

success.description: The vial shatters behind you. You scrape a coin or two from the residue.
Elixir of Undermining. Brann beams like it was the plan all along.

failure.description: You caught the wrong end. Acid eats into the coin pouch and keeps eating.

desperate_option.label: Redirect the throw toward the wealthiest digger in the guild

success.description: Brann approves. Someone wealthy, somewhere, is suddenly less wealthy.

failure.description: The vial boomerangs. The potion is inside you now, and it burns.

name: Zekvir's Lair
description: A webbed pit. Eight red eyes and eight legs. Above the pit, a faint '??' flickers.
Zekvir's Angler's Web coils around the chamber. He's been waiting.
The ?? tier door is unlocked. Zekvir's maw is already open.

success.description: You give Zekvir a wide berth. He does not pursue.
You survive the Claw Smashes. The Web Terrors leave a chest behind.

failure.description: Angler's Web pulls you in. You escape with bruises and a shorter coin pouch.

success.description: Nobody has killed ?? tier. You just did. The loot is unreal.

failure.description: Zekvir devours you whole. Your pack reappears empty at the tunnel mouth.

name: Kriegval's Candle
description: An Enchanted Candle waits at the room's entrance. Smothering Shadows pool in the corners.
You know how this one works. Light the candle. Keep moving. It burns fast when you run.
Kriegval's Rest never forgave a slow foot. The candle is already half gone.

safe_option.label: Walk slowly and shield the candle

success.description: You conserve the flame. Steady coin at a steady pace.
The candle stutters but holds. You clear the room with a handful of coin.

failure.description: The Smothering Shadows take the flame. You lose the room in the dark.

success.description: Candle out at the exit — a second too late for the Shadows. Huge haul.

failure.description: Candle out mid-room. The ceiling follows it.

name: Mycomancer Cavern
description: Pink Sporbits drift along patrol routes. Their AoEs flicker in rhythm.
The Mycomancer Cavern glows bioluminescent. You count three Sporbit patrol loops.
Fungal cavern. Bright-pink orbs on circuits. You can see the pattern if you watch.

success.description: You slip through on the timing gap. No coin, but no Sporbits either.
Threaded it. A fungal cache waits in the far alcove.

failure.description: A Sporbit's AoE catches you. Spores in the pack, coin on the floor.

success.description: Every Sporbit in the room pops in sequence. The aftermath is all yours.

failure.description: The chain misfires. You are at the epicentre.

name: Restored Coffer
description: A Restored Coffer sits on a stone altar. Your Coffer Key fits, barely.
The coffer lid is gilded. The Delver's Journey card in your pack suggests you can try for more.
Bountiful? Gilded? The altar offers both doors.

safe_option.label: Bank the key for a deeper run

success.description: You pocket the key. No coin now, but it's still yours.
A tidy Restored Coffer pull. Cosmetics flagged, coin counted.

failure.description: The coffer was trapped — a bad pull on a bad key.

desperate_option.label: Gamble the key at the Gilded Stash

success.description: Seven Myth Dawncrests spill into your pack. The week is made.

failure.description: The stash was picked clean. Your key is ash.

name: Chain Frost
description: Lich's orb of Chain Frost hovers at the cavern mouth. It does not care who's adjacent.
The frost finds three diggers at once. Yours, and two others in the network.
You cast Chain Frost. It never bounces just once.

success.description: You weather the pass. A small expense for a clean tunnel.

risky_option.label: Cast Chain Frost and let it bounce

success.description: The frost lands ten times and pays in crystallized coin.

failure.description: The frost bounces back. Your pack is iced shut.

name: Divine Rapier
description: A Divine Rapier juts from the rubble. Heat wafts off the blade.
The Rapier hasn't been claimed. The previous owner is a scorch mark on the wall.
You know the rules. Pick it up and the next cave-in drops it back on the floor.

success.description: Scraps of creep carcass; a small coin in the ash.

risky_option.label: Pick it up and sprint to the next checkpoint

success.description: You clear the tunnel without incident. Rapier sold, pockets heavy.

failure.description: The Rapier drops at the cave-in. You don't.

success.description: Two checkpoints later the Rapier is still yours. Nobody can believe it.

failure.description: A cave-in. A Rapier drop. A very rich stranger a tunnel over.

name: Event Horizon
description: Enigma's Black Hole anchors a side passage. It is pulling at everything with mass.
The pull is gentle. The thing at the center is not.
Rocks, ore, and the silhouettes of two distant diggers drift slowly toward the sphere.

success.description: You take the long way around. It is much longer than you expected.
The edge scours your pack and leaves coin behind as sediment.

failure.description: A partial pull. You leave a lot on the other side.

desperate_option.label: Drag two diggers in with you

success.description: The three of you enter. Only you come back out. Pockets full.

failure.description: The Hole has opinions about this plan.

name: Wisp Tether
description: A gold-and-white orb drifts beside you. A tether line flickers to a distant digger.
Io's tether wants a partner. Somewhere in the network, another digger just felt a tug.
The wisp hums. The tether is soft, then insistent.

success.description: The wisp fades. You pay a small tribute for its time.
The tether holds. You move a little faster, pay a little less.

failure.description: The tether snaps. The wisp leaves with a grudge.

success.description: The tether sings. Your partner feels the haul land in their pack too.

failure.description: The tether yanks you both the wrong way. You eat the loss.

name: Refresher Shard
description: A Refresher Shard crystal is wedged into the wall. Purple light doubles your shadow.
The shard hums at the frequency of cooldowns. A second cast is waiting for you.
Rubick is not here, but you feel watched anyway.

success.description: You bank the shard. A modest finder's bounty for the find.
The next event fires twice. Both land clean.

failure.description: Both casts miss. The shard shivers apart in your hand.

desperate_option.label: Activate on this event, right now

success.description: The Refresher refreshes itself. The cave gives twice over.

failure.description: Two casts, two misfires. The cave answers with a collapse.

name: Aegis Whisper
description: A half-buried shield rim glints in the dirt. The metal hums with an old promise.
Something circular is pressed into the wall — a shield, ancient, still warm.
You hear a faint chant from the rock. The stone wants you to make an offering.

success.description: You walk past. The chant fades.

risky_option.label: Pay coin into the buried shield

success.description: The shield drinks your coin and breathes a faint protective glow over you.

failure.description: Your coin sinks into the dirt. Nothing happens.

name: Echoing Mime
description: A pale figure performs a silent show in the gloom. Other diggers always seem to stop and watch.
The mime tilts its head at you. Somewhere in the network, picks go still.
It bows. A polite, silent invitation to be made a fool of.

success.description: You keep digging. The performance ends without applause.
You out-perform it. The mime tips a coin into your palm.

failure.description: The mime doesn't break character. You feel small.

name: Crow Snipe
description: A delivery crow flaps past, a heavy pouch swinging from its talons.
A messenger bird overhead — laden, slow, oblivious.
Something glitters in the bird's grip as it crosses overhead.

success.description: The bird carries on its way.
The pouch hits the dirt at your feet. Someone wealthy is having a worse day than you.

failure.description: You miss. A guard's whistle sounds; you pay a fine to slip away.

name: Smoke Detour
description: A drifting purple haze hides a shortcut through someone else's tunnel.
The smoke pools in a side passage. You can almost see through to the other tunnel network.
A cloaked path opens up. The air tastes like other people's progress.

success.description: You stay the course. Steady progress.
You shortcut clean through and pop out ahead, pockets heavier.

failure.description: The smoke clears around the wrong people. Two diggers' caches collapse.

name: Stranger's Lamp
description: An ornate brass lamp is wedged into the wall. You feel the urge to rub it.
The lamp is still warm. Something inside is waiting to be asked for a favor.
A genie's lamp, half-buried. You half-remember warnings about wishes.

success.description: You step around it. Some wishes aren't worth making.

risky_option.label: Spend a wish on the lamp

success.description: The genie grants you riches — and tosses a coin to a stranger for good measure.

failure.description: The lamp coughs out a puff of soot. You're 5 coin lighter for the trouble.

name: Drill Sergeant
description: A spectral sergeant blocks the passage and starts barking orders.
DOWN! UP! DOWN! UP! The ghost will not be ignored.
A phantom drill sergeant materializes, whistle in hand. You stand at attention by reflex.

success.description: You sneak through during a count. The ghost never notices.
You complete the drill. The ghost salutes and dissolves; your form has never been better.

failure.description: The drill never ends. By the time the ghost is satisfied you've lost track of the days.

name: Pit Lord's Toll
description: A massive horned figure looms in the dark, rattling a cup of bone dice.
A horned silhouette gestures at a pile of skulls. He wants to play.
The pit lord smiles. The kind of smile that costs other people money.

success.description: He shrugs and lets you pass. You lose a step backing away.

risky_option.label: Roll the pit lord's bone dice

success.description: The dice land in your favor. The pit lord grins and pays out.

failure.description: The dice land badly. The pit lord cackles, and three diggers feel the floor drop.

name: Damned Bottle
description: An ornate bottle whispers two names in the dark — yours, and a stranger's.
The bottle sweats a faint blue light. It is full, and it remembers who filled it.
A sealed vessel hums. Cork it, the whispers stop. Uncork it, things get interesting.

success.description: You walk on. The whispers fade.
The bottle unfastens itself from another digger's stash. The contents are now yours.

failure.description: The bottle was a curse. It empties your pockets in answer.

name: Roshpit Gambit
description: An ancient pit yawns open. Tribute paid by the wealthy lines its rim.
A pit older than the mine. Coins from the richest pockets keep washing up at its edge.
The pit hums at a frequency only large balances can hear.

success.description: You give the pit a wide berth. Boring, safe.
You surface clutching a king's ransom. Two of the richest just felt it leave their stash.

failure.description: The pit takes its tribute from you instead.

name: Wilderness Stalker
description: A masked figure has been tracking you through the deep tunnels. They are no longer subtle.
Footprints behind yours. Then closer. Then close enough to hear breathing.
A stranger steps from the dark, blade drawn. They've been waiting for you.

success.description: You go still until they pass. You lose ground but you keep your purse.

risky_option.label: Strike first and take the stalker's purse

success.description: You drop them in one strike and lift their take. Whoever they were, they were carrying.

failure.description: They were better than you. You drag yourself away wounded and lighter.

name: Wisp's Tether
description: A drifting mote of light recognizes you. As you cup your hand around it, a second mote pulses awake somewhere far above.
The wisp leans toward your warmth, then tilts — as if it can hear someone else who needs it more.

success.description: The mote drifts away. The cave is colder for its absence.

risky_option.label: Chase the wisp into the gloom

success.description: The wisp doubles in your palm. A second flicker brightens far above.

failure.description: The mote burns out. The dark closes in and your bearings go with it.

name: Tunnel Echoes
description: Your pickaxe rings wrong. Stone shifts somewhere it shouldn't have.
The walls carry your mistake to places you can't see. Someone there feels it.

success.description: You ease the swing. Slow and quiet pays a small dividend.
The stone gives clean. Your strike lands where you wanted.

failure.description: Your strike rolls long. Something gives way somewhere else.

name: Stalled Caravan
description: A wagon wheel half-sunk in dirt. A faint voice asks if you're going their way.
Tracks lead nowhere. The cart still smells of oil, recently.

success.description: You don't get involved. The voice fades.

risky_option.label: Lend a shoulder for a fee

success.description: The wheel pops free. The driver presses coin into your palm and is gone.

failure.description: The wagon lurches loose and slams the props. The passage caves in around you.

name: Volatile Affix
description: A jagged crystal pulses with a rhythm that doesn't match the cave. Pressing it is an invitation.
The shard hums against your palm in a key the rock doesn't share.

success.description: You leave the shard humming. Some bargains aren't worth the noise.
The hum settles into your bones. The next few swings feel charged.

failure.description: The shard cracks against your palm and the hum cuts out.

name: Rival's Cache
description: A camouflaged stash, tucked behind a false stone. Someone deliberate left this. They'll know.
Tools laid out. Marks fresh. You aren't the first one here today.

success.description: You reseal the stone and walk on. Some rivals you don't poke.
The stash gives. Whoever stocked it is going to feel that.

failure.description: A snare you didn't see takes its toll.

name: Forsaken Pact
description: A voice from the cracks offers a deal. The wording is careful. Too careful.
The dark proposes. The terms aren't only for you.

success.description: You walk away. The voice charges a small fee for your time.
The pact pays out in your purse. The voice keeps its end.

failure.description: The cost of breaking the deal pours through the cracks. Others nearby feel it.

name: Mapworks Drift
