description: A folded map unfurls itself in midair. It points to riches in places no one has dug yet.
Lines redraw themselves on the parchment. Several names brighten — none of them yours.

success.description: You tuck the parchment away. Some directions you don't follow.
The map sings. You return heavy, and you weren't the only one paid.

failure.description: The lines led nowhere that exists. You wander the dark, hours lost.

name: The Eye Opens
description: A seam in the rock parts. An eye looks back. It is not blinking. It is listening.
The dark watches you watching it. The transaction has already started.

success.description: You look away. The dark accepts the courtesy and lets you through.
The eye blinks once. Something it had been holding for someone else slides into your hands — and you find you can read the stone the way it does.

failure.description: It looks longer than you do. The cave answers for both of you.

success.description: The dark answers in your own voice. Several caches change hands. You leave knowing things about the rock that no one teaches.

failure.description: Your voice carries somewhere it shouldn't. The cave folds in on you.

name: Overture of the Hollow Court
description: Something old turns to face you in the dark. There is a hush, then a single chord — a voice you do not recognize asking if you have brought tribute.
The tunnel ends in a doorway that should not be here. A hush sits behind it, attentive.
You step into a chamber that listens before you speak. A formal stillness, like a court before its monarch arrives.

success.description: You bow without breaking eye contact and back into the corridor. The court remembers courtesy.

risky_option.label: Cross the unsettled floor to the throne

success.description: You walk the length of the hall. Something nods, very slightly. You are permitted to continue.

failure.description: You misstep on a tile that wasn't there. The court does not laugh.

name: Audience with the Hollow Court
description: The chamber widens. Figures you cannot quite focus on take their seats around you. A question is being asked, though no one has spoken.
Three thrones, three figures, three questions. None of them are for you. You are merely allowed to listen.

success.description: You learn nothing you can repeat aloud. But you understand something about the tunnels you didn't before.

risky_option.label: Answer the question that was not asked

success.description: The court goes still. One of the figures rises and offers you something small and very old.

failure.description: Whatever you said, it was wrong. The chamber dims a degree.

name: The Court Recesses
description: The figures stand without sound. Doors that were not there a moment ago open onto corridors you have never seen.
A recess is called. You are not invited to follow. You are also not asked to leave.

safe_option.label: Take the corridor that leads back

success.description: You return to your tunnel with the certainty that something is now keeping track of you.

risky_option.label: Take the corridor that leads further

success.description: You walk a little further than wisdom suggests. When you come back you find a small offering tucked into your pack.

failure.description: The corridor folds you back, but the dark keeps a long stretch of your time.

name: Crimson Drizzle
description: A fine red rain leaks from the ceiling. It does not pool — it stains.
The drip is warm. It hisses on your lantern and writes nothing.
Red beads gather on your sleeves. You can feel them counting.

success.description: You shelter. The drizzle thins.

risky_option.label: Press on through the staining rain

success.description: You break out the other side, stained but ahead.

failure.description: The rain finds something on you and takes it.

name: Glyph Pulse
description: A glyph drawn in old salt thrums on the wall. It wants something.
The mark on the stone tightens, then relaxes. Tightens, then relaxes.
A faint figure-eight glyph hums where you set your hand.

success.description: You give the glyph a wide berth.

risky_option.label: Press your palm to the salt-glyph

success.description: Heat runs into your arm and you feel quicker.

failure.description: The glyph drinks your offering and gives nothing back.

name: Mossfire Echo
description: A sickly green flame curls up out of the rock. It is too bright for what it is.
The green fire here has no fuel, and it knows you can see that.
A patch of fel-bright flame waits in a crack. It has been waiting a long time.

success.description: The fire forgets you and folds back into the rock.

risky_option.label: Feed a coin to the fel flame

success.description: The flame breathes in. Its warmth wraps your shoulders, sharp as iron.

failure.description: The fire takes your coin and burns colder.

name: Mana Fountain Crack
description: A vein of bright water has cracked the wall. It tastes of summer storms.
A spring breaks open at your feet. It smells like a struck flint.
Cold sweet water leaks through stone that should not leak.

safe_option.label: Sip a little, leave the rest

success.description: You drink politely. Your lantern feels heavier.

risky_option.label: Drink your fill from the bursting spring

success.description: The spring fills you up and you set off, brimming.

failure.description: Something in the water bites back.

name: The Hooked Stranger
description: A chain unspools from a hole that should not be there. It rattles, listening.
Something on the far side of the wall throws a hook and waits.
A heavy hook drags through the rock and stops near your boot.

success.description: You let the chain drift. It withdraws, disappointed.
Whatever was on the other end drops what it carried at your feet.

failure.description: The chain pulls back. Something comes off you when it lets go.

name: Whispering Token
description: A coin made of teeth glints in the dust. It is whispering a price.
The token in the dirt is too warm to be metal.
A coin sits where no one dropped it. It hums when you breathe near it.

success.description: You walk past. The whispering follows for a while, then fades.
The token settles into your bag and pays out a debt you didn't know you'd struck.

failure.description: The token bites your palm shut and takes its price.

name: The Beast's Pit
description: The tunnel widens into a pit whose bottom is full of slow eyes.
A reek rolls up from a drop. Something below shifts its weight.
An old pit yawns ahead. The dust in it is breathing.

success.description: You skirt the lip and lose a little ground.
The thing below flinches. You climb out with a fistful of someone else's spoils.

failure.description: It catches you on the way down. You leave bloody.

name: Aegis Denial
description: A shattered ward thrums against your fingers. It would like to be whole again.
Pieces of an old ward are scattered like teeth. They click when they sense each other.
A broken ward leans against the wall. It is trying to remember its purpose.

success.description: You leave the ward and the moment passes.

risky_option.label: Pay to bind the broken ward

success.description: The ward chooses a target and pulls. The coin it tears loose is someone else's.

failure.description: The ward chooses you. The shards take their tribute.

name: Sanguine Pact
description: A vein in the stone runs hot. It is asking for a sip of yours.
A red bead floats in the air at chest height, waiting.
Something has tied a thread of blood between two walls. It hums.

success.description: You refuse. The thread snaps and the air settles.

risky_option.label: Open a finger for the blood-pact

success.description: The pact takes its cut and quickens your hands.

failure.description: The pact takes more than was offered.

name: Time Walker
description: Bronze sand drifts up from the cracks in the floor. The seconds drag with it.
A grain of slow time hangs at chest height. Touching it would be the easy part.
Time has settled here like silt. Even your breath comes back to you twice.

success.description: The bronze sand drains away. The corridor returns to normal speed.
You take three strides for one. Your tunnel jumps a long way ahead.

failure.description: Time snaps back hard. The walls come with it.

name: Bounty Marker
description: A small brass marker has been driven into the rock. It carries a name in scratchwork.
Someone has nailed a sigil to the wall. It points at gold somewhere up the line.
A marker hums against the stone. It is aimed away from you.

success.description: You walk past. Whoever it points at stays unmolested.
The marker fires. Wealth bleeds out of someone with too much of it.

failure.description: The marker turns on you mid-trip.

name: Mage's Archive
description: An archive in a side-cavity has gotten damp. The pages still glow.
Someone left a book on a shelf carved into the wall. The ink moves.
A small library has been embedded in the rock. It is reading itself aloud.

success.description: You leave it for whoever finds it next.

risky_option.label: Read a passage from the moving book

success.description: A useful page settles into your head.

failure.description: The book takes your coin and writes a name in it. Yours.

name: Phantom Strike
description: Three of you take the next swing. Two of them aren't quite there.
The pickaxe doubles. So do you. Briefly.
Your shadow takes a step before you do. So does your reflection.

success.description: You shake the doubling and dig on.
Three swings land at once. Coin scatters and most of it sticks.

failure.description: Two of you miss and take it out on the third.

name: Silken Cocoon
description: The corridor has grown a chitin ribcage. Old silk sticks between the plates.
Black silk and shed carapace make a webwork across the path. Something is asleep in it.
Spider-bones and webbing fill the next stretch. The web is fresher than the bones.

success.description: You pick between the carapace plates. Slow but unscathed.
Chitin cracks under your shoulder. The next swing comes easy.

failure.description: The silk takes pieces of you with it. Something stirs deeper in.

name: The Mother's Mark
description: A great unblinking eye opens in the stone wall. It tracks you without pity.
An eye the size of a wagon wheel watches from inside the rock. It does not blink.
Something behind the wall has put an eye through. It is not yet finished pushing.

success.description: You keep your eyes down. The pupil drifts away.
It sees you back. Something in your shadow changes weight.

failure.description: It looks past you. You feel its displeasure on your back.

name: Helltide Bell
description: A bell that no one has ever cast tolls inside the rock. The air thickens.
Far below, a bell that should not exist begins to ring. The walls hum with it.
A great red note rolls through the tunnel. The whole mine shifts to its key.

success.description: You hold your hands to your ears. The sound passes through.

risky_option.label: Pay the price and strike the bell

success.description: Your blow lands. The toll rolls through the whole mine and stays.

failure.description: The bell rejects your hand. You leave coin on the floor.

name: The Sundering
description: A long crack in the wall opens like an eye and watches.
Something old is splitting along its joints. The dust rearranges itself in patterns.
A shape under the rock breaks into pieces and the pieces still know each other.

success.description: You retreat. The crack closes its eye.
The crack flinches and gives up something it had been holding.

failure.description: The crack opens wider. It is in you now.

name: The Black King's Bargain
description: A black-iron stave is pressed into the wall. Its inscription is in a king's hand.
An old contract has been engraved into the stone. It has a place for your name.
A length of iron bar leans against the rock. A king's bargain hums in it.

success.description: You decline. The bar dims.
The bar warms in your grip. Nothing in this stretch can touch you.

failure.description: The bar takes your tribute and offers nothing back.

name: The Old God's Tongue
description: A great tongue of black stone protrudes from the wall and licks the air.
Something on the other side of the rock is tasting the corridor.
A black stone tongue has unrolled across the floor. It knows your weight.

success.description: Walking on the tongue costs you blood instead of coin.
The tongue tastes the coin and lets you through.

failure.description: The tongue tastes more than offered.

name: Crimson Rain Ladder
description: The rain in this stretch is climbing back up. It has somewhere to be.
A ladder of red water rises through the ceiling. It has hands.
The drizzle reverses. It is going up to find someone.

success.description: You let the ladder finish climbing.
You go up alongside the rain. It splashes the rest of the mine on the way.

failure.description: The ladder lets go. You come down with it.

name: Etched Tile
description: A flat tile of dark glass juts from the wall, faint glyphs scored across its face. It is warm to the touch.
Among the dirt you find a fragment of patterned glass, glyphs half-rubbed clean. It hums when you breathe on it.

success.description: You let it be. The hum follows you a few steps and stops.

risky_option.label: Pry it loose and pocket it

success.description: It comes free with a clean click. Useful weight.

failure.description: It shatters in your hand. Shards bite.

desperate_option.label: Press your palm against the glyphs

success.description: The tile reads you back. A pattern lodges in your head and stays.

failure.description: Heat lances up your arm. You drop it; the glyphs go dark.

name: Brass Coupling
description: Half-buried in the wall, a piece of dark brass — a coupling, jointed like a finger. Same glyph-set as the tile.
You strike something that does not break. Brass, articulated. The same hand made the tile.

success.description: You move on. It clicks once behind you.

risky_option.label: Work it loose with your pickaxe

success.description: It comes free in your palm, articulating against itself.

failure.description: The pickaxe slips. You leave skin on the brass.

desperate_option.label: Fit it to the tile in your pack

success.description: Brass meets glass. Both go warm. The pattern is one step closer to whole.

failure.description: Both pieces seize. You almost lose them in the dirt.

name: Reagent Vial
description: A stoppered vial, somehow unbroken, lying as if placed. The liquid inside moves on its own.
You uncover a small vial, its contents reading the room — pooling toward whichever wall is nearer.

success.description: You pack the dirt over it. The liquid stills.

risky_option.label: Open it and pour out a drop

success.description: A bead of it lands on your glove. It evaporates upward, smelling of rain.

failure.description: The vial pops in your hand. The reagent reaches for you.

desperate_option.label: Pour the whole vial onto the brass

success.description: Brass drinks. The pattern flares — somewhere a tunnel coughs in sympathy.

failure.description: The reagent burns through everything in your pack.

name: Glyphed Door
description: The tunnel opens into a chamber that should not be here. A door, half-sized, set with the brass and glass you have been gathering.
A door waits, fitted with sockets in the shape of every piece you have collected. It opens to whatever you choose to do.

success.description: You memorize the door. It hums politely as you go.

risky_option.label: Fit the pieces and turn the lock

success.description: Tumblers fall. Something inside the door pays attention.

failure.description: The pieces refuse each other. The door grows cold.

desperate_option.label: Force the door open while it's still warm

success.description: It gives, reluctantly. A long corridor breathes in welcome.

failure.description: The door rejects you. Heat lashes the chamber.

name: The Inner Room
description: The corridor ends at a workshop, abandoned mid-experiment, every surface dusted in reagent. A larger contraption hangs over a bench, expectant.
You step into a room that has been waiting. Tools on the bench are arranged for one more user. The contraption above hums on a frequency you have learned to hear.

safe_option.label: Take what you can carry and leave

success.description: You pocket what is loose and go. The room stays patient.

risky_option.label: Sit at the bench and try the simplest joining

success.description: Reagent meets brass meets glass. The room exhales gold.

failure.description: Your joining fails loudly. The bench scorches.

success.description: Reagent floods the chamber and rolls outward through every tunnel. The guild's mine drinks it for an hour.

failure.description: The contraption fires in the wrong direction. Most of the reagent is wasted.

name: Bone Fragment
description: Something small and white in the dirt. Too pale for stone. The shape of a finger.
You uncover a bone splinter, polished as if it has been waiting.

success.description: You cover the bone. The air thanks you in a way you cannot name.
Cold against your hip. Heavier than it should be.

failure.description: It crumbles to powder. The air goes thin.

desperate_option.label: Whisper a name to the bone

success.description: Something far below sits up to listen.

failure.description: Wrong name. Wrong everything. The dirt tightens around your ankles.

name: Wight Scout
description: A figure in the dark, watching from where there should be no figure. Rags. No face. Patient.
It does not block your path. It only stands there and counts your breaths.

success.description: You walk past. It does not turn its head.
It accepts. The coin disappears. Your pack feels noticed.

failure.description: It does not want coin. It wants a name. You do not give one.

desperate_option.label: Ask the watcher who sent it

success.description: It gestures further down. A road opens that was not there before.

failure.description: It turns its facelessness fully on you. You forget several minutes.

name: Lich's Emissary
description: Robes that move on their own breeze. A crown of teeth. Polite as a clerk and twice as patient.
An emissary, clearly. He has a ledger. He is checking your name against something.

success.description: He marks something and waves you on. The ledger sighs.
He smiles. The signature pays for itself somewhere down the line.

failure.description: Your hand cramps on the page. Something is taken in the gap.

desperate_option.label: Steal a page from the ledger

success.description: The page comes loose; another digger's name fades from a wall somewhere.

failure.description: He catches your wrist. The ledger drinks from you in payment.

name: Raise or Banish
description: A circle of bones laid out by someone careful. In the center, a small skull, expectant.
Inside the circle, a question without words. You can wake what is here. You can also send it away.

success.description: Bones roll into dirt. The chamber relaxes.

risky_option.label: Banish what waits in the circle

success.description: Something thin slips out and out and out until it isn't.

failure.description: Banishing requires conviction. You lacked it.

desperate_option.label: Raise it and ask its name

success.description: It rises and gives a name. You write it where you'll find it again.

failure.description: What rises is not what was buried.

name: Audience with the Necromancer
description: A long room of standing dead, all turned toward a chair at the far end. The chair is occupied. The occupant has been waiting.
You arrive in a hall too big for the tunnels. Cold light. A figure on a throne, who has read every page of the ledger and chosen which to keep.

success.description: You retreat. He does not begrudge it. The hall stays for next time.

risky_option.label: Offer service in exchange for safe passage

success.description: He accepts a small service. The room marks you as useful.

failure.description: He laughs. The standing dead laugh with him.

desperate_option.label: Demand a token of his authority

success.description: He is delighted by the impertinence. He hands you a cloak from his own shoulders. It moves of its own accord.

failure.description: Impertinence has a price. He extracts it from your bones.

name: Hieroglyph in the Dirt
description: A glyph etched into the tunnel wall, fresh enough that it should not be here. The shape of a dragon, mid-coil.
Someone has been scratching dragons into the rock. The lines are too clean for a digger's hand.

safe_option.label: Smear it out and move on

success.description: You wipe the glyph; the wall keeps the memory of it.
The line completes under your touch and stays warm.

failure.description: Your finger cuts on the glyph; the cut does not bleed for a while.

desperate_option.label: Spit on it and rub the spit in

success.description: The dragon takes a small interest in you. A coin appears at your feet.

failure.description: The wall takes the spit and gives nothing back.

name: Coin That Refuses
description: A coin in the dirt, the wrong shape and the wrong metal. It refuses to be picked up at first.
You bend for what looks like jopacoin and find your hand will not close on it.

success.description: You walk on. The coin keeps refusing whoever passes.
Leverage works where fingers did not. The coin yields, sullenly.

failure.description: The coin bites the tool. Your grip rings for an hour.

success.description: You promise the next thing you find. The coin lifts itself into your hand.

failure.description: It accepts the wrong promise. You feel poorer in a way coin cannot fix.

name: Hoarded Pile
description: A small mound of coins someone has been adding to, one at a time. Other diggers' work. Not yours.
You stumble into a deposit that was meant to grow into something. The pile is not yours, but the chamber is empty.

safe_option.label: Add one of your own coins, take none

success.description: Your tithe lands on top. The pile leans toward you.

risky_option.label: Skim a few coins off the pile

success.description: You take a few. The pile remembers the shape of the hand that took them.

failure.description: The pile collapses and yours collapses with it.

success.description: You scoop it all. The chamber chooses someone else to feel the lack.

failure.description: The pile remembers everything you took and forgets nothing.

name: Draconic Tribute
description: An altar. The dragon glyph again, larger now, scaled in coin. A space cleared in front of it for whatever you bring.
The altar is patient. It accepts. It has been accepting from people for longer than you have been alive.

success.description: A coin disappears into the altar. You feel lighter and slightly observed.
You give what stings. The altar warms. Something in you marks the loss as deposit.

failure.description: Your share is judged inadequate. You leave it anyway.

desperate_option.label: Empty your pack onto the altar

success.description: You pour out everything. The altar approves in a register reserved for fools and heirs.

failure.description: Generosity is taken for weakness. The altar takes more than you offered.

name: The Inner Vault
description: A door of dragon-shaped brass at the back of a chamber you should not have found. The altar's payments have all been going somewhere.
The vault, finally. The door knows your name from the ledger of every tribute you have left.

success.description: You record the location in your head and back out. It will be here.
The door opens politely. A modest sample of the hoard is yours.

failure.description: Your name does not match the ledger today.

success.description: The door yields what it has been holding. Something with teeth nods at the bargain.

failure.description: Hoards object. This one objects with teeth.

name: The Hungering Dark
description: The dark down here has a preference. It drifts, slow and certain, toward the heaviest purses in the mine.
A cold pressure builds in the tunnel — pointed away from you, toward whoever is holding the most.
Something in the black is sniffing for weight. You aren't carrying enough to interest it. Yet.

success.description: You keep your head down and let it drift past. You're not worth its hunger.

risky_option.label: Point it uphill at the rich

success.description: You turn its hunger toward the fattest stashes in the deep. The cold takes its bite from them.

failure.description: It turns on you instead. Briefly. Rudely.

name: Deny the Seam
description: A seam of pure ore runs off toward a wealthier claim than yours. You could work it quietly — or bring the roof down so no one richer ever gets it.
The vein is good, and it isn't only yours. There's a way to make sure it stays no one's.
Someone with deeper pockets has been mining toward this exact seam. You got here a few swings ahead.

success.description: You chip out a modest share and move on before anyone notices.
You collapse the whole seam into dead rock. Somewhere above, a very fat claim just got lighter.

failure.description: The collapse catches your own footing. You limp off with less than you came with.

name: Turf War
description: Two things far bigger than you are fighting over this stretch of dark. The walls are not going to survive it.
A roar answers a roar. The tunnel between them — where you happen to be standing — is about to become collateral.
Two apex things have claimed the same ground. You can use that, if you're quick and stupid in the right order.

success.description: You give the brawl a wide berth and pocket what you can on the way out.
They crash together right where you wanted. The shockwave buries stashes for half the deep.

failure.description: You misjudge the timing. One of them turns on you instead.

name: Smoke Ambush
description: A bank of grey haze fills the tunnel. Move through it and nobody will see you coming.
The smoke swallows your lantern and your footsteps both. Somewhere ahead, a digger works with their back turned.
Cover, thick and sudden. Whatever you do in here, no one will be able to swear it was you.

success.description: You let the haze settle before moving on. Slow, but clean.
You're on them before they hear you. In the scramble their coin scatters into cracks no one will ever reach.

failure.description: The haze thins at the worst moment. They see you first, and you pay for it.

name: The Tear
description: A seam of absolute black opens where solid rock should be. It is not empty. It is hungry, and it is whispering.
Something behind the dark leans closer when you go still. It wants what everyone up there is carrying.
The tear breathes. The whispers know your name, and several others besides.

success.description: You wall it back up. The whispering fades, reluctantly.
It feeds. Across the deep, a dozen purses lighten by exactly the weight the dark decides to take.

failure.description: It closes before it can feed. You lose your bearings in the dark it leaves behind.

name: The Deep Hunter
description: Something enormous has been pacing the deepest tunnels. It hunts whatever has gone furthest down.
Claw-marks the size of doors. Whatever left them prefers the bold — the ones who dig deepest.
It's tracking the deepest scent in the mine. That isn't you. Not yet.

success.description: You keep above its hunting line and slip away unnoticed.
You point it at the deepest trail in the mine and carve your cut from the wreckage it leaves behind.

failure.description: It loses the deeper scent and circles back to the nearest one. Yours.

name: Collapsed Armory
description: A buried armory rattles under a cracked slab. Every weapon inside has outlived its owner and seems pleased about it.
Rusty blades poke through a collapsed weapons rack. The ceiling is losing an argument with gravity.

success.description: You spend good coin on braces and leave the weapons to their retirement.
The roof holds. The weapon objects, but your pack has seniority.

failure.description: The roof files a grievance directly against your purse.

name: Dead Prospector's Pack
description: A dead prospector still hugs a travel pack. The straps look newer than the prospector.
You find a miner who finally stopped digging. Their pack has not accepted the decision.

success.description: You leave a small burial tithe. The pack stops following you with its buckles.
The prospector lets go. The armor inside has only minor opinions about inheritance.

failure.description: The corpse keeps the pack. The floor takes two blocks and an administrative fee.

name: Spore Debt
description: Mushrooms bloom into a ledger with your name already damply signed at the bottom.
A fungal clerk unfolds from the wall and presents an invoice for breathing nearby.

success.description: You pay the mushrooms. They stamp PAID across a lung-shaped page.
The clerk loses your file in a puff of spores. Its boots are now evidence.

failure.description: Collections arrive from the ceiling. They compound aggressively.

name: Clockwork Toll
description: A frozen turnstile counts down from a number it refuses to explain.
Brass hands reach from the ice, each holding the same tiny bill for time already spent.

success.description: The clock accepts your coin and returns none of your time.
The gears cough up a trinket and several seconds that probably belonged to someone else.

failure.description: The mechanism bills your purse and puts the rest of your afternoon in escrow.

name: Surveyor's Cairn
description: A cairn of numbered stones marks tunnels that do not appear on any living survey.
Survey pins circle a low stone mound. A silver loop holds the oldest map shut.

success.description: You copy the reliable bearings and leave the sealed map where it lies.
The cairn settles behind you. Its surveyor's ring fits as if it measured your hand.

failure.description: Every copied bearing shifts at once. You pay to find the tunnel you just left.

name: Ruinwager Vault
description: A vault door offers odds instead of a lock. The numbers improve whenever the ceiling groans.
An iron betting window opens in bare stone. Something below it is taking wagers on you.

success.description: The cheap route is narrow, honest, and pointed in the correct direction.
The vault pays in old coin and a signet warm from somebody else's losing hand.

failure.description: The house keeps your route, your stake, and several load-bearing stones.

name: Red Thread Shrine
description: Red thread crosses a buried shrine in hundreds of taut lines. One loose end waits for a finger.
A hand-shaped altar holds a single red loop. Every snapped thread around it points deeper.

success.description: You tie off a failing support line and follow its tension deeper.
The shrine pulls once against your pulse, then releases the ring and a hidden path.

failure.description: The loose end was holding the chamber together. The shrine collects its thread.

name: Collector's Roots
description: Roots knot around a coin press labeled COLLECTIONS. It has already found two other accounts.
A root-fed ledger lists every active digger in sap. Your name is underlined twice.

success.description: You settle your line. The roots add a tasteful little checkmark.
The roots amend the ledger. Two other tunnels receive the invoice with no appeal form.

failure.description: The roots recognize your handwriting and collect the forgery fee immediately.

name: Hungry Beacon
description: A black beacon flashes whenever an active digger finds coin. It looks underfed and entrepreneurial.
A signal lamp made of teeth sweeps three distant tunnels, then turns its appetite toward you.

success.description: You pay the beacon. It dims to the warm glow of temporary satisfaction.

risky_option.label: Aim it at the other tunnels

success.description: The beacon feeds across three tunnels and leaves you the crumbs. The crumbs are excellent.

failure.description: It remembers who touched the controls. You are, unfortunately, very local.

name: Sealed Reliquary
description: A reliquary sealed in black wax, hairline-cracked from your pick. The wax won't re-set — whatever's inside is waking up, and it won't go back to sleep for free.
A flat obsidian case, older than any market that could price it, humming faintly. One in a thousand holds a true black-petaled prize; the rest are salted forgeries that bite the hand that opens them.
The seal is breaking on its own now. Smother it — at a cost — or gamble on whatever a long-dead collector thought worth locking away this deep.

safe_option.label: Smother the seal and eat the cost

success.description: You pack the seal in wet clay and buy off the residue with a handful of coin. It goes quiet. You're out the coin.

risky_option.label: Crack it open for the prize

success.description: Black petals, intact and real. You pocket a fortune the collector never lived to spend.

failure.description: A forgery. The case bursts into salted glass and takes a bite out of your purse on the way down.

name: Grenth's Tithe
description: A frost-shrine blocks the seam, rimed white. The cold here belongs to the god who keeps the dead, and he does not let the living pass for free.
Reapers wait at the shrine, patient as the grave. One holds out a skeletal hand. The toll is small. Refusing it is not.
Grenth's mark is cut into the ice. Pay the tithe and pass, or test how fast you are against things that have all of eternity to wait you out.

success.description: You leave coin at the frost-shrine. The reapers part. The cold takes its due and no more.

risky_option.label: Refuse and slip past the reapers

success.description: You dart through a gap in the cold and rifle a reaper's frozen cache on the way out.

failure.description: The cold closes around you. Grenth takes far more than the tithe would ever have cost.

name: Rhystic Tollgate
description: A toll-rune flickers across the seam, keyed to the heaviest purses in the guild. It asks little of the rich — which is exactly why they never pay it willingly.
You find the bones of an old tithe-engine. Wind it up and it skims a quiet tax off whoever in the guild can most afford it.
The gate hums when wealth passes near. It does not care about yours — it's already counting three richer pockets up above.

success.description: You pull the toll-rune apart for parts. A modest, honest wage.
The gate wakes and skims a tithe off the three fattest purses in the guild, routing the treasure straight into yours.

failure.description: The rune misfires and bills you instead. Embarrassing, and expensive.

name: The Underworld Reclaims
description: A spectral ledger unrolls in the dark, written in a reaper's hand. It lists the guild's richest hoards, and it is long overdue for an audit.
A reaper's bell hangs in the seam. Ring it, and the Underworld remembers what the living merely borrowed — and dissolves a cut of it back into the Mists.
Ectoplasm beads on the walls, leaking from somewhere that wants its wealth returned. The gilded up above will feel the draft first.

success.description: You let the reaper's accounting lie and dig on. A small, clean find.
The bell tolls. The Underworld audits the three richest hoards in the guild and dissolves a cut of each back into the Mists. You keep a finder's share.

failure.description: The cold reads your ledger instead. The reapers take their audit out of your own purse.

name: Second-Life Ledger
description: A brass ledger lies open beside a silent bell. The page for second chances has your name on it and a fee already entered.
A clerk-shaped shadow waits behind a stone counter. Its hourglass is empty, but its hand remains outstretched.
The tunnel ends at an old revival office. A gold deficit glows beside your name, and the timer is still running.

success.description: You settle the fee. The shadow closes the ledger and lets you pass poorer, but punctual.
The ledger accepts the early signature and releases someone else's forfeited deposit.

failure.description: The timer resets. The clerk charges the full deficit and an impatience fee.

name: Twin-Scar Altar
description: A red altar bears one fresh scar and one empty groove. The second mark promises perfection or nothing at all.
Something valuable has already survived the altar once. The stone is eager to learn whether it can survive twice.
Two crimson channels cross the altar's face. One is dry. The other is waiting for your offering.

success.description: You feed the altar enough coin to close the empty groove. The stone keeps every piece.
The second scar blooms cleanly. The altar sheds a cache it had been saving for a worthy result.

failure.description: The second mark consumes the first, the offering, and a generous bite from your purse.

name: Ember Clearinghouse
description: A many-faced brass engine turns around a coal-bright core. Three heavy accounts glow on its inner walls.
The clearinghouse counts wealth by the heat it throws. Tonight, three ledgers are burning white.
A cube of nested gears wakes at your approach. It has already selected the fattest balances in the guild.

success.description: You feed the engine a small stack. It files the payment under unavoidable friction.
The engine clears three swollen accounts through the flame and spits you a modest operator's share.

failure.description: The core rejects the transfer and clears its operating cost directly from you.

name: Abandoned Forge
description: A forge still holds a dull red heat. Three tools rest where their smith left them.
Hammer marks lead to a workbench that should have rotted decades ago.

success.description: You restore a careful edge for the next hard fight.
The forge roars awake and yields one intact preparation kit.

failure.description: The bellows rupture and bury the bench under hot stone.

name: Salted Threshold
description: A precise circle of black salt surrounds a doorway with no room behind it.
Someone warded this seam from the inside.

success.description: You bottle the clean edge of the ward without crossing it.
The false doorway folds away, leaving a cache of warding supplies.

failure.description: The circle closes behind your shadow and takes the light with it.

name: Frayed Lifeline
description: A rescue cache hangs over a shaft whose bottom refuses your lantern light.
A line is still tied off here, though its owner is long gone.

success.description: The old rope is sound enough to soften one bad retreat.
You return with a sealed kit and a much better knot.

failure.description: The anchor tears loose. The shaft keeps what falls past you.

name: Quartermaster's Niche
description: A numbered niche contains supplies for a crew that never checked back in.
Three waxed parcels wait beneath a tally of unfinished shifts.

success.description: The label was honest: one useful preparation, still dry.
The lock gives before the ceiling does. The best parcel is yours.

failure.description: The locker was holding the wall together. It is not anymore.

name: Collapsed Armory Cache
description: A crushed rack shows the outlines of tools made for very particular miners.
Bent lockers surround one compartment the collapse failed to open.

success.description: You leave the strange metal alone and recover a practical kit.
Inside waits a tool built around a dangerous idea.

failure.description: The compartment opens downward. So does the floor.

name: Relic-Bearing Strata
description: A narrow band of stone has grown around several objects that do not belong here.
The seam hums around the outline of something old and useful.

success.description: You avoid the humming core and recover what the stone released freely.
The stone parts around a relic that seems relieved to be found.

failure.description: The seam answers with a resonance that empties your hands and your memory.

name: Prospector's Last Pack
description: A pack sits neatly beneath a name carved out of the wall.
Someone cached their finest equipment beside a route they chose not to return from.

success.description: You honor the arrangement and take what was meant for a stranger in trouble.
The wrapping falls away from a keepsake that still remembers its owner.

failure.description: The pack's last knot was a warning. The tunnel collects its due.

name: Song Below Stone
description: A melody passes through solid stone, pausing whenever you breathe.
The mine sings a tune no living crew should know.

success.description: You copy enough of the rhythm to steady one future encounter.
The mountain answers. When the echo fades, a slate of music rests at your feet.

failure.description: Something sings your name back in the wrong voice.

name: First Descent Cartography
description: A survey station is pinned beneath ice that predates every tunnel record.
A brass map case bears the seal of an expedition nobody remembers sending.

success.description: The practical markings lead you to a sealed rescue cache.

risky_option.label: Trace the route with no destination

success.description: The blank route inks itself toward a chamber behind you. The original map remains.

failure.description: The route folds. You emerge far above the station with frost in your purse.
